contact_name.value: Tolessa Deksissa, Ph.D. Director, Water Resources Research Institute (WRRI) Director, Professional Science Master's Program, and Environmental Quality Testing Laboratory

services.value: Offers full-service environmental sampling and analysis, including high-quality reliable and affordable analytical and field sample collection services. Analytical testing includes metals and elemental analysis, plant nutrients, semi-volatile organic compounds (pesticides), microbiology (Fecal Coliform), soil pH/water hardness/total alkalinity, plus customer services such as electronic data deliverables, data interpretation, chain-of-custody and sampling container labels, and sample collection (DC only) and courier services.
